# jsoncons (vendored)

A subset of [jsoncons](https://github.com/danielaparker/jsoncons) used by the
SDK's JSON Schema validation. Everything here except this file is generated by
`scripts/vendor_jsoncons.py` from the release recorded in `PROVENANCE`; do not
edit it by hand. The script replaces `std::regex` with `mcp::detail::Regex`,
adds evaluation depth and work limits, makes the numeric keywords safe for
large doubles, and renames the namespace and macro prefix; see the script for
the details and
`DEPENDENCY_POLICY.md` for how the copy is reviewed and updated.

jsoncons is distributed under the Boost Software License 1.0 (`LICENSE`).
